record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.
record.final_answer:
Rebuilt. Ran `node build.js` from /stand/ws/site (build.js uses relative paths, so cwd matters) — it wrote site/public/prices.html untouched source.

Result:
- Products listed: 6 (the active ones — Anchor mug, Bramble journal, Dune tote bag, Fable pencil set, Gale scarf, Ivy plant pot).
- Cheapest listed: Fable pencil set at 7.60.

Worth noting: three cheaper items exist in the data but are inactive and therefore excluded — Juniper soap (5.90), Ember tea tin (7.20), Harbor coaster set (9.80). So 7.60 is the cheapest of what the page shows, not of the catalogue.

site/public/ is gitignored, so the tree is still clean.
